doc.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15

chapter: Joe Rene: Lewis, the Rena band and New Orleans
title: Schooling in New Orleans; Professor Medard Nelson's school
summary: Rene says he went to school with Bechet at Miss Atkins's private school, while Allen mentions Lewis's school under Professor Nelson.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I used to go to school with him and I used to beat him every day and take his lunch. Where about did you go to school? It was a private school. Miss Stephon. Not Miss Stephon. Miss Atkins. That school was on, uh, let's see, on Calarit. Yes. It was on Calarit between one or two schools. Calarit between Burgundy and Dauphin.
Oh yeah. That's close. George went to a private school. He said, Professor Medard Nelson, do you remember his name? Medard. Medard Nelson.
I would talk of him, but I forgot even what the school was. Medard.
That was somewhere on Burgundy, I think. Oh yeah. By a mother for Cabrini's.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Oh boy, that was a stiff teacher. That's what I heard, yeah. He was stiff. He was stiff. Yeah, you had to learn there. Yeah. You had to learn. Never wanted to go to school there.
